reasons_add: Burhan allows worldly life or the barzakh as the stay, but says worldly life is the more apparent referent.
Qushayri describes a long stay beneath the earth; Burhan also allows the barzakh as the referent.
Burhan says the different descriptions as a morning, evening, or hour reflect each person's own estimate.
Burhan says the different descriptions as an hour, morning, or evening reflect each person's own estimate.

Qushayri attributes the apparent brevity of the stay beneath the earth to the terror of seeing the Resurrection. Burhan says the perceived length also varies with the severity or lightness of the experience.
